title.en: Conveying the Lands Reclaimed or to Be Reclaimed in the Area of North Harbor, Manila By the Manila International Port Terminals Inc. Singly or Jointly With Other Entities

text.en:
Notwithstanding any provisions of law, decree, rules, or regulations to the contrary, and as a
matter of public interest, the Government Service Insurance System is hereby authorized to extend financial
assistance to the Manila International Port Terminals Inc. under such terms which transaction(s) shall be
subject to the approval of the President of the Philippines.

In consideration of the financial assistance to be extended by the Government Service Insurance
System pursuant to Section 1 hereof, all lands already reclaimed as described in Presidential Decree No. 634,
or to be reclaimed by the Manila International Port Terminals Inc., either singly or jointly with the Department
of Public Works, Transportation and Communications, or other entities, together with the resulting foreshore
areas, irrespective of the sources of funding, shall be conveyed, transferred, and ceded to the Government
Service Insurance System as additional contribution of the National Government to augment the actuarial
solvency of the Retirement Insurance Fund. For this purpose, the foreshore lands to be reclaimed shall be
reclassified as industrial lands.

The lands reclaimed and to be reclaimed including the foreshore lands shall be surveyed by the
Bureau of Lands to ascertain their accurate location, boundaries, and areas. Thereafter, the reclaimed lands so
verified shall be registered and titled in the name of the Government Service Insurance System and the
Register of Deeds shall issue the corresponding certificate of title to the GSIS.

The reclaimed areas shall be leased by the Government Service Insurance System to the Manila
International Port Terminals Inc. for a period of twenty-five (25) years, renewable for another twenty-five (25)
years, at lease rentals to be determined on the basis, among others, of the total investments and commitments
to be recovered by the GSIS plus a fair and reasonable profit thereon in consideration of the right, privilege,
and authority granted to the Manila International Port Terminals Inc. to utilize such areas. The lease shall be
mutually agreed upon by the President of the Philippines, but no case shall it impair or prejudice any privilege
granted to the MIPTI under Presidential Decree No. 634.

Any provision of law, proclamation, ordinance, rules, and regulations to the contrary

notwithstanding, the Government Service Insurance System may, subject to the approval of the President of
the Philippines, transfer or convey ownership of any portion or portions of the lands reclaimed and convey the
same to persons or corporations qualified to acquire land under the Constitution, or lease the same or any
portion or portions thereof to any person or corporation for commercial or industrial purposes only.

All laws, executive orders, proclamations, rules, and regulations or part thereof, inconsistent
with this Decree are hereby replaced and/or modified accordingly.
All offices concerned are hereby directed to act accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 18th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-five.
